verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'splashdown around 8:07 p.m. ... off the coast of San Diego'; R2: 'splash down in the Pacific Ocean off San Diego, Calif.'; R3: 'Pacific splashdown off California'; R5: 'splash down off the coast of San Diego'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state splashdown off San Diego coast in Pacific Ocean.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Friday, April 10' (in 2026 context per URL and update note); R2: 'on Friday' (2026 context); R4: 'Friday, April 10' (April 10, 2026 event)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly name Friday, April 10 in 2026 mission context.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down at approximately 5:07 p.m. PDT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
